The '''Archenar system''' was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Archenar asteroid field]] was the theater of a [[Battle of the Archenar asteroid field|battle]] concluded with a Republic victory.<ref name="TOR" />
